diagnosis: Repeated actions without progress are overrepresented in candidate/bad runs: 1,485 repeated operations versus 224 in base/good runs (6.63×), for a net bad excess of 1,261.
expected_mechanism: A progress checkpoint prevents unchanged-state action loops by forcing reassessment and a materially different approach. Expected cost: small state-tracking and reasoning overhead, with occasional premature pivots when delayed progress is legitimate.
policy_text: Before repeating an action on unchanged state, compare the latest observation with the prior one. If the previous attempt produced no material progress, do not retry unchanged: identify the failure cause, alter the target, parameters, tool, or strategy, or stop and report the blocker.

quantitative_evidence.finding: Candidate/bad runs contain 1,485 repeated operations, including 679 repeated clicks and 441 repeated no-ops.
Base/good runs contain 224 repeated operations in magnitude, including 40 repeated clicks and 85 repeated no-ops.
The differential profile reports +1,261 repeated operations, with positive excesses of +639 clicks, +356 no-ops, and +277 scrolls.
